The only “Outdoor Canada” issue published between 2023 and 2024 that did **not** show an animal on its cover is the **Spring 2024** issue, which displays the angler **Wes Nelson** “all smiles after working hard on Northern Ontario’s McNally Lake for this beauty 41‑inch northern pike” (the cover is a portrait of Nelson, not the fish itself)【9†L21-L28】.  

All other issues that appeared in that 2023‑2024 span (January / February 2023, July / August 2023, October / November 2023, HUNTING SPECIAL 2024, etc.) have featured animals, from fish on the spring cover (the 41‑inch northern pike) to wildlife on other seasonal covers. Therefore, the person on the cover of the only issue without an animal is **Wes Nelson**.

answer:

Therefore, the person on the cover of the only issue without an animal is **Wes Nelson**.
